title: Frames-contract-aligned controlled proxy public SDK surface
measurement_boundary: Official upstream interfaces with coordinator-owned proxy bindings. Native Counso fork/workspace/publish/function-runner availability has not been verified.
host_provider: The host already wraps the default-exported React component with the official FrameFunctionHooksProvider. No required props. Do not recreate the provider or access host control state. FrameRoot is an optional presentation container, not a provider.
task_function: Only bare load-data declared by this package; input/output task schemas are in interaction_contract.json. The host registers deterministic synthetic read logic, with no other model/agent or external service. The supplied function entrypoint is controlled task-data code, not a claim that a native sandbox runner ABI was verified.

FrameRoot.props: children:ReactNode required; HTML div props; theme?:Partial<Record<`--${string}`, string|number>>; style?:CSSProperties & FrameTheme
FrameRoot.behavior: Presentation only. Theme variables inherit; explicit style overrides theme.

readFile.content: file.text() returns Promise<string>; the return is FrameFile metadata, not File directly.
readFile.unavailable: null does not distinguish missing file, permission or read/network failure.

writeFile.boundary: Only the existing permitted ./draft.json can be written. Read revision/canWrite first; preserve opaque revision exactly. Confirmed success supplies a new revision. save_failed is unconfirmed, not proof authority is unchanged.

useFile.implementation: Declared read-only proxy hook. Initially null/asynchronous, returns raw browser File only; no revision/canWrite metadata or persistence promise.

callFunction.boundary: Bare manifest name, not frameId/name. Validate returned task shape. Errors may reject. No candidate-controlled cross-package function identity.

useFrameFunction.behavior: Official query hook; name=null disables. Input is required. Previous data may remain during revalidation, and must not be mislabeled as current results. No automatic error retry, focus or reconnect revalidation; deduping interval 2000ms. Explicit mutate is available for revalidation.

useFrameFunctionMutation.behavior: Official mutation hook; isLoading aliases isMutating. name=null disables; trigger then rejects. reset clears hook result, not business authority.

SandboxFunctionCallError.signature: class extends Error; readonly code:string; readonly status?:number; constructor({code,message,status?})
SandboxFunctionCallError.behavior: Function error codes are open strings, not a hidden enum.

triggerUserFileDownload.implementation: Proxy-supported local download; requires actual user activation. No external transmission.

unsupported_or_not_task_required: captureScreenshot throws in the minimal proxy and cannot establish observer evidence. This is the minimal task surface, not a claim of every native export. UseUserIdentity/authentication is unnecessary for these synthetic tasks.
file_paths: Package-relative ./dataset.json or ./resources.json/./draft.json, as declared per task. No ../, absolute, cross-package or substitute-file creation. Only current task read/write paths are permitted.
revisions: Revision metadata may be null. Available tokens follow the verified positive decimal representation, but are opaque to the UI; do not infer, increment or construct revisions.
type_dependencies: SDK_API.d.ts uses React types and the official SWR KeyedMutator type for declarations only; this does not authorize extra runtime imports.
